name: Color Sweeper
description: Read colour clues, work out which tiles they are talking about, and solve a grid with a reason for every tile.
author: Koda Math Lab

features.name: Spoken voice
features.description: Reads the question aloud, speaks hints, and says why a move was not allowed. Turn off for a silent lesson.

features.name: Sound chimes
features.description: Plays a short sound when a tile is chosen and when an answer is checked.

features.name: Haptic vibration
features.description: Adds a small vibration to a correct answer and to a move that was not allowed.

features.name: 1-to-1 badges
features.description: Numbers the tiles as they are chosen, so a child selecting eight of them can see how many are already in.

features.name: Step framing tags
features.description: Labels warm-up, guided, activity and milestone steps.

settingsSchema.label: Warm-up tag
settingsSchema.help: Custom wording for the first step.

settingsSchema.label: Final tag
settingsSchema.help: Custom wording for the last step.

settingsSchema.label: Speech rate
settingsSchema.help: How fast Koda speaks the question and hints.
